user.title: Set up Wochenkorb
user.description: Brochure offers for a postal code and a list of search terms.

data_description.products: Type a term and press Enter to add it, remove it with the cross. Each term creates offer sensors.
data_description.retailers: Empty: all retailers. Otherwise only offers of the selected retailers; you can type your own names.
data_description.mealie_recipes: Needs the Mealie integration. Shows recipes whose main ingredient is on offer.
data_description.shopping_list: Optional. Main ingredients already on this list are marked in the recipe suggestions.

error.products_required: Please enter at least one search term.

menu_options.general: General: postal code, search terms, retailers
menu_options.recipes: Recipes: suggestions, vegetarian/vegan, exclusions, cooking time

general.title: General
general.description: Changes apply at once; sensors of removed search terms are cleaned up.

data_description.products: Type a term and press Enter to add it, remove it with the cross. Each term creates offer sensors.
data_description.retailers: Empty: all retailers. Otherwise only offers of the selected retailers; you can type your own names.
data_description.mealie_recipes: Needs the Mealie integration. Shows recipes whose main ingredient is on offer.
data_description.shopping_list: Optional. Main ingredients already on this list are marked in the recipe suggestions.

recipes.title: Recipe suggestions
recipes.description: Applies to the new suggestions in the recipe card. Planned dishes are shown in the week strip regardless.

data.meatless: Of these without meat and fish
data.meat_bonus: Meat and fish without a crossed-out price

data_description.suggestions: The card shows this many recipes that are not planned yet.
data_description.meatless: 0: no requirement. Same number as above: only such suggestions. If fewer matching recipes fit the offers, slots stay empty or, with a smaller number, are filled with others.
data_description.meatless_kind: Vegan is detected from the ingredients (no meat, fish, dairy, egg, honey) and can be wrong.
data_description.exclude_ingredients: Recipes with one of these words in the name or the ingredients are not suggested, for example mushrooms. The recipe search still finds them.
data_description.max_time: In minutes; 0: no limit. Recipes without a time stay in the suggestions.
data_description.repeat_days: A recipe is not suggested for this many days after it was cooked; 0: no pause.
data_description.meat_bonus: How much an offer for meat or fish counts even when no old price is given.
data_description.quick_entries: The buttons in the window for an own entry in the week strip, at most eight. Empty: the default again.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Each list groups search terms and becomes its own tab in the offers card. Its offers are shown there instead of under the retailer.

data_description.name: Shown on the tab, for example Obst.
data_description.terms: These terms are searched even if they are not among the search terms.
data_description.exclude: Offers whose name contains one of these words are hidden (for fruit, for example juice or yoghurt).
data_description.delete: The terms of the list are no longer searched afterwards unless they are among the search terms.

error.products_required: Please enter at least one search term.
error.list_name_exists: A list with this name already exists.
error.list_terms_required: Please enter at least one term.

options.off: not at all (only the discount counts)
